script_text: Cancer, the Moon’s tide surges this week, pulling hidden emotions to the surface and urging insight. Monday the Moon trines Mercury in your third house, boosting intuitive communication and swift decisions. On Wednesday the Sun squares Neptune in the twelfth house, creating confusion and over‑thinking personal goals. Thursday Mercury stations direct at 22° Cancer, ending retrograde fog and restoring clarity to your routine. Friday Venus conjoins your fifth house, igniting romance and boosting creative confidence. Saturday Saturn opposes your tenth house, demanding discipline and steady effort to advance career. Sunday the Sun sextiles Pluto in the seventh house, empowering partnerships and giving you confidence to assert needs. Friday is your love day as Venus conjoins your fifth house, igniting romance. Saturday is toughest as Saturn squares your tenth house, demanding extra effort. Channel the Moon’s water energy by journaling each night to turn emotions into action. Follow for daily updates.
